question: How do gemini compounds perform as antiwear agents, friction reducers, and corrosion inhibitors compared to PEG300 aqueous lubricant?
answer: Gemini compounds demonstrated higher performance efficiencies as antiwear agents, friction reducers, and corrosion inhibitors compared to PEG300 aqueous lubricant. These compounds were synthesized from the reaction of dibasic acid with N,N-diethyl-2-aminoethanol followed by reaction with p-toluene sulfonic acid and were used as additives in lubricating oils.
